text: こくばんにも　かいたが…　わしに　わからぬ　ことは　ない　ゲームボーイの　なかに　せかいが　あることも！

structure.jp: こくばんにも　かいたが…
structure.en: I wrote it on the blackboard too, but...

structure.jp: わしに　わからぬ　ことは　ない
structure.en: there is nothing I don't know

structure.jp: ゲームボーイの　なかに　せかいが　あることも！
structure.en: even that there's a world inside the Game Boy!

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ぬ is an old-fashioned ない, the 'not' ending, used here to sound like a wise old man. わからぬ　こと = 'things I don't understand'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a part of the sentence means 'but' or a soft lead-in to what comes next. かいたが = 'I wrote it, but'.

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.span: せかいが　あること
patterns.explanation: こと after a verb turns the whole statement into 'the fact that'. せかいが　あること = 'the fact that there is a world'.
